tools.name: search_providers
tools.description: Search Tewdy for service providers (plumbers, translators, tutors, cleaners, etc.) by category and/or location. Returns a ranked list including name, rating, response time, and Tewdy profile tag.

tools.name: get_provider_details
tools.description: Look up the full public profile for a Tewdy provider. Accepts either a Tewdy UUID (returned by search_providers as `id`) or a tewdyTag handle (e.g. "marcus-chen", returned as `tewdyTag`). Returns name, jobTitle, bio, profile picture, languages, capability pricing, ratings, verification status, and t

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the service categories Tewdy supports (plumbing, translation, tutoring, cleaning, etc.). Returns slug, name, description, and businessType for each. Use this to map a free-text user request to a known category before calling search_providers. Optional business_type filter (e.g. "individual", "c

tools.name: get_category_pricing
tools.description: Get aggregated price ranges for a service category, optionally filtered by location. Prefers transacted prices (accepted quotes) when at least 5 samples exist; otherwise falls back to listed (asking) prices from provider capability pricing. Returns median, p25, p75, min, max, sample size, and curren

tools.name: get_earnings_estimate
tools.description: Estimate weekly and monthly earnings for a Tewdy provider in a given category. Uses listed hourly rates from existing providers as the baseline and projects earnings under three utilisation scenarios (40%/60%/80%). Returns ranges, not guarantees.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Compose a Tewdy quote request from the user's description. Returns a deep link to the Tewdy app with all fields pre-filled; the user reviews and clicks publish to actually post the request. This tool deliberately does not auto-post — quote acceptance and payment confirmation always happen on tewdy.c

tools.name: get_my_requests
tools.description: List the authenticated user's quote requests with current status (open / closed / cancelled / expired) and quote-response counts. Read-only — no state changes. Requires authentication.

tools.name: accept_quote
tools.description: Look up a quote and return a deep link to the Tewdy app where the user can confirm acceptance and proceed to payment. This tool deliberately does not accept or pay — quote acceptance and payment confirmation always happen on tewdy.com via the deep link, not in chat. Requires authentication.

tools.name: message_provider
tools.description: Send a chat message into an existing Tewdy thread (typically created when a quote was submitted or accepted). The chat_id is the same id surfaced by get_my_requests or accept_quote. Requires authentication.

tools.name: list_inbound_requests
tools.description: For the authenticated provider, list open quote requests that match the provider's capabilities and service area. Optional filters: category, location radius, budget range, urgency. Read-only. Use this to find work to quote on. Requires authentication.

tools.name: submit_quote
tools.description: Submit a quote on an open quote request. The provider sets the estimated price, optional duration and availability, and a short message to the requester. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_categories" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List the service categories Tewdy supports (plumbing, translation, tutoring, cleaning, etc.). Returns slug, name, description, and businessType for each. Use th…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "request_quote" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Compose a Tewdy quote request from the user's description. Returns a deep link to the Tewdy app with all fields pre-filled; the user reviews and clicks publish …

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.tewdy.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_quote · Public sink: request_quote, message_provider, submit_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_quote · Public sink: request_quote, message_provider, submit_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
